_comment: Compass optional hooks. Disabled by default. The onboarding skill asks whether you want to enable automatic ingestion and briefings — if you say yes, it writes the appropriate settings. To enable manually, set your project .claude/settings.json 'hooks' block to include these entries.

PostToolUse._name: auto-ingest on file drop into documents/
PostToolUse._status: example only — copy into .claude/settings.json to activate
PostToolUse._comment: Triggers a quiet /update --ingest pass whenever a file is written into documents/. Requires the claude CLI to be on PATH.

hooks.command: echo '$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.file_path // empty' | grep -q '^.*documents/' && claude -p '/compass:update --ingest --quiet' --no-interactive || true

Stop._name: briefing on session end if due
Stop._status: example only — copy into .claude/settings.json to activate
Stop._comment: Sends the daily briefing email (if configured and due) when a session ends cleanly.

_scheduled_task._comment: For hourly background updates (configured during onboarding), Compass uses a crontab entry. The onboarding skill writes this when you opt in to scheduled updates.
_scheduled_task._note: Replace $COMPASS_CASE_DIR with the absolute path to your case folder.
